After: same source selection with only lagged_cross_source_consensus added at 1.25x paper notional. PnL is recomputed from selected row pnl_pct_net and scaled notional.

pre_run_questions.3_single_causal_variable: One fixed policy bundle: add source_notional_scalar=1.25 for selected lagged_cross_source_consensus allocator rows, while accepted laggard/revision/peer-shock/turn-of-month scalars, source selection, rank, daily top-1, hold, costs, cooldown, core behavior, LLM/news, and live/default orders remain fixed.
pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md canonical three windows. Before is the current accepted allocator including exp-032, exp-001, and exp-006 source scalars; after adds only lagged_cross_source_consensus 1.25x. Accept only if aggregate EV/PnL improve, no window EV/PnL regression, affected consensus sample spans all three windows with >=20 rows, survival/concentration/drawdown guards pass, and the after allocator still beats accepted comparators.

prediction.confidence_reason: Mechanism is capital allocation to an already selected accepted allocator source rather than changing source rank or adding tickers. The current allocator probe shows lagged_cross_source_consensus is still selected 42 times across all three canonical windows with about $12,074 net paper PnL after the accepted laggard/revision/peer/turn source scalars, but this is a near-neighbor allocation test and may be in-sample.

execution_envelope.cash_management_note: idle bucket cash may sit in the accepted low-deployment ETF substitute at operator level; not part of sleeve trade policy
execution_envelope.kill_switch_calibration_note: 15pct is about 1.5x the worst healthy-window giveback (about 10pct of peak equity in late_strong); calibrated on frozen windows, so the in-sample no-false-trigger check is partially circular and the binding validation is OOS plus genuine forward rows (exp-20260612-024)
execution_envelope.slippage_model: entry/exit 5bps plus ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT per quant/fill_model.py and quant/constants.py; conservative for 4k USD orders above the ADV floor

production_impact.parity_note: If accepted, historical replay and daily default-off snapshots use the same shared accepted-helper allocator source_notional_scalars. If rejected, no shared helper, run adapter, daily snapshot, live orders, or core behavior changes are retained.
